تستلذون (form X)
# تَسْتَلِذُّونَ (tastaliḏḏūna) /tas.ta.lið.ðuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# تُسْتَلَذُّونَ (tustalaḏḏūna) /tus.ta.lað.ðuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
